name: app.R
content:
# app.R
# Safe drinking water, country by country: an R Shiny app on the WHO/UNICEF
# JMP estimates (2000-2024). Mohamed Bougrara.
#
# Structure:
#   R/donnees.R        data loaded once, pure functions (tested)
#   R/i18n.R           English and French strings, number formats
#   R/theme.R          bslib theme (light and dark), compiled by publier.R
#   R/statiques.R      CSS and JavaScript published as static files
#   R/graphique.R      custom Shiny output for plotly.js (www/graphique.js)
#   R/tableau.R        HTML tables built with htmltools
#   R/mod_carte.R      world map module        -> returns the clicked country
#   R/mod_pays.R       country profile module  -> exposes selectionner()
#   R/mod_regions.R    regions and 2030 module
#   R/mod_classement.R ranking module, CSV export
# Shiny sources every file of R/ before running this one.
#
# Run locally: shiny::runApp("_shiny/eau-potable")
# Published as a static site with shinylive (webR): see publier.R.

# Quiet start: under webR, the « masked » notices of package loading make R
# fetch its message translations (3 MB) for nothing.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(shiny)
  library(bslib)
})

# Explicit app-wide cache for bindCache(): shared by all sessions, bounded in
# memory. Under webR (shinylive) Shiny has no default cache object.
shinyOptions(cache = cachem::cache_mem(max_size = 64 * 1024^2))

ui <- page_navbar(
  id = "onglets",
  title = textOutput("titre_app", inline = TRUE),
  window_title = "Safe drinking water, country by country · Mohamed Bougrara",
  theme = theme_app(),
  fillable = c("carte"),
  header = tagList(
    dependances_statiques(),
    tags$head(tags$meta(name = "author", content = "Mohamed Bougrara"))
  ),
  nav_panel(textOutput("nav_carte", inline = TRUE), value = "carte", icon = icone("globe-americas"),
            carte_ui("carte")),
  nav_panel(textOutput("nav_pays", inline = TRUE), value = "pays", icon = icone("flag"),
            pays_ui("pays")),
  nav_panel(textOutput("nav_regions", inline = TRUE), value = "regions", icon = icone("graph-up"),
            regions_ui("regions")),
  nav_panel(textOutput("nav_classement", inline = TRUE), value = "classement", icon = icone("list-ol"),
            classement_ui("classement")),
  nav_panel(textOutput("nav_apropos", inline = TRUE), value = "apropos", icon = icone("info-circle"),
            uiOutput("apropos")),
  nav_spacer(),
  nav_item(radioButtons("langue", NULL, choices = c("EN" = "en", "FR" = "fr"), inline = TRUE)),
  nav_item(input_dark_mode(id = "mode", mode = "light"))
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Language: ?lang=fr in the address opens the app in French (read by
  # www/graphique.js, which also sees the address of the shinylive page).
  # One source of truth for the language, fed by the address or by a click.
  langue <- reactiveVal("en")
  observeEvent(input$lang_url, once = TRUE, {
    if (input$lang_url %in% c("en", "fr")) {
      langue(input$lang_url)
      updateRadioButtons(session, "langue", selected = input$lang_url)
    }
  })
  observeEvent(input$langue, ignoreInit = TRUE, {
    if (input$langue %in% c("en", "fr")) langue(input$langue)
  })
  lang <- reactive(langue())
  sombre <- reactive(identical(input$mode, "dark"))

  output$titre_app      <- renderText(tr("app_title", lang()))
  output$nav_carte      <- renderText(tr("nav_map", lang()))
  output$nav_pays       <- renderText(tr("nav_country", lang()))
  output$nav_regions    <- renderText(tr("nav_regions", lang()))
  output$nav_classement <- renderText(tr("nav_table", lang()))
  output$nav_apropos    <- renderText(tr("nav_about", lang()))

  clic <- carte_server("carte", lang, sombre)
  pays <- pays_server("pays", lang, sombre)
  regions_server("regions", lang, sombre)
  classement_server("classement", lang, sombre)

  # Modules talking to each other: a click on the map opens that country.
  observeEvent(clic(), {
    pays$selectionner(clic())
    nav_select("onglets", "pays")
  })

  output$apropos <- renderUI({
    l <- lang()
    div(class = "container about", style = "max-width: 760px; padding: 24px 8px;",
      h2(tr("about_title", l)),
      p(tr("about_data", l)),
      p(tr("about_build", l)),
      h3(tr("about_skills", l), style = "font-size: 1.15rem; margin-top: 1.5rem;"),
      tags$ul(lapply(tr("skills", l), tags$li)))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

name: R/donnees.R
content:
# donnees.R
# Data loaded once per R process, shared by every session, and the pure
# functions the modules call. Pure functions take data in and return data out:
# they are tested without starting the app (tests/testthat).

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

D      <- readRDS(file.path("data", "eau.rds"))
ANNEES <- range(D$eau$year)

PAYS <- D$zones[D$zones$type == "Country", ]
PAYS <- PAYS[order(PAYS$area), ]
CONTINENTS <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(PAYS$continent)))
REVENUS <- unique(PAYS$income[order(PAYS$income_order)])
REVENUS <- REVENUS[!is.na(REVENUS)]

INDICATEURS <- c("safely", "basic_plus", "surface")
MILIEUX <- c("Total", "Urban", "Rural")

# Country choices for a select input: names shown, ISO3 codes returned.
choix_pays <- function() stats::setNames(PAYS$code, PAYS$area)

# Value of one indicator for every country, for one year and one residence.
carte_valeurs <- function(eau, indicateur, milieu, annee) {
  stopifnot(indicateur %in% INDICATEURS, milieu %in% MILIEUX)
  d <- eau[eau$year == annee & eau$residence == milieu & eau$code %in% PAYS$code,
           c("code", indicateur, "population")]
  names(d)[2] <- "valeur"
  merge(PAYS[, c("code", "area", "continent", "income")], d, by = "code", all.x = TRUE)
}

# Time series of one area (all residences).
serie <- function(eau, code) {
  d <- eau[eau$code == code, ]
  d[order(d$residence, d$year), ]
}

# Latest year with a value, and change since 2015 (or the first year after).
derniere <- function(eau, code, indicateur = "safely", milieu = "Total") {
  d <- eau[eau$code == code & eau$residence == milieu & !is.na(eau[[indicateur]]), c("year", indicateur)]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(list(annee = NA, valeur = NA, evolution = NA, depuis = NA))
  d <- d[order(d$year), ]
  base <- d[d$year >= 2015, ][1, ]
  fin <- d[nrow(d), ]
  list(annee = fin$year, valeur = fin[[indicateur]],
       evolution = if (is.na(base$year) || base$year == fin$year) NA else fin[[indicateur]] - base[[indicateur]],
       depuis = base$year)
}

# The 2015-2024 pace continued until 99 %, the JMP threshold for universal
# access. Same method as the Power BI report (straight line between the two
# years): it gives 2062 for the world.
projection <- function(eau, code, debut = 2015, fin = 2024, cible = 99) {
  v <- function(a) eau$safely[eau$code == code & eau$year == a & eau$residence == "Total"]
  s0 <- v(debut); s1 <- v(fin)
  if (!length(s0) || !length(s1) || is.na(s0) || is.na(s1)) return(list(rythme = NA, annee = NA, etat = "inconnu"))
  rythme <- (s1 - s0) / (fin - debut)
  if (s1 >= cible) return(list(rythme = rythme, annee = fin, etat = "atteint"))
  if (rythme <= 0) return(list(rythme = rythme, annee = NA, etat = "jamais"))
  list(rythme = rythme, annee = ceiling(fin + (cible - s1) / rythme), etat = "projete")
}

# Ranking table for one year, with the filters of the Ranking tab.
classement <- function(eau, annee, continent = NULL, revenu = NULL) {
  d <- eau[eau$year == annee & eau$residence == "Total" & eau$code %in% PAYS$code,
           c("code", "safely", "basic_plus", "surface", "population")]
  base <- eau[eau$year == 2015 & eau$residence == "Total", c("code", "safely")]
  names(base)[2] <- "safely_2015"
  d <- merge(d, base, by = "code", all.x = TRUE)
  d$evolution <- d$safely - d$safely_2015
  d <- merge(PAYS[, c("code", "area", "continent", "income", "income_order")], d, by = "code")
  if (length(continent)) d <- d[d$continent %in% continent, ]
  if (length(revenu)) d <- d[d$income %in% revenu, ]
  d[order(-d$safely, -d$basic_plus, d$area, na.last = TRUE), ]
}

# Regional aggregates published by the JMP (world, SDG regions, income groups).
regions <- function(eau, type = c("SDG region", "Income group")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  z <- D$zones[D$zones$type %in% c(type, "World"), c("code", "area", "type", "order")]
  d <- eau[eau$residence == "Total" & eau$code %in% z$code, c("code", "year", "safely")]
  merge(z, d, by = "code")
}

name: R/graphique.R
content:
# graphique.R
# A custom Shiny output for plotly.js charts (see www/graphique.js), and the
# small helpers that build figures as plain R lists.
#
#   graphique_output("id")            UI: the container
#   output$id <- render_graphique(..)  server: returns list(data, layout)
#   input$id_click                     the customdata of the clicked point

graphique_output <- function(id, height = "100%", min_height = "300px") {
  # "../": under shinylive the app runs in shiny-eau/app_<id>/, and these
  # files are published next to it, in shiny-eau/, as plain static files:
  # downloaded compressed and cached by the browser, never served by R.
  # Locally (runApp) "../" resolves to the root, where www/ is served.
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::htmlDependency("plotly", "2.25.2", src = c(href = ".."), script = "plotly.min.js",
                              all_files = FALSE),
    htmltools::htmlDependency("graphique", "1.1", src = c(href = ".."), script = "graphique.js",
                              all_files = FALSE),
    htmltools::div(id = id, class = "graphique-output",
                   style = sprintf("width:100%%;height:%s;min-height:%s;", height, min_height))
  )
}

render_graphique <- function(expr, env = parent.frame(), quoted = FALSE) {
  func <- shiny::installExprFunction(expr, "func", env, quoted, label = "render_graphique")
  shiny::createRenderFunction(func, function(value, session, name, ...) {
    if (is.null(value)) return(NULL)
    # Plain JSON, NA as null (plotly leaves a gap).
    jsonlite::toJSON(value, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null", na = "null", digits = NA)
  }, outputFunc = graphique_output)
}

# One trace. Vectors stay arrays even with one element (I() keeps them so).
trace <- function(...) {
  t <- list(...)
  for (k in c("x", "y", "z", "locations", "customdata", "text")) if (!is.null(t[[k]])) t[[k]] <- I(t[[k]])
  t
}

# Layout shared by every chart: transparent background, text colour and grid
# that follow the light or dark mode. Extra arguments are merged in.
mise_en_page <- function(sombre = FALSE, ...) {
  texte <- if (isTRUE(sombre)) "#e2e8f0" else "#1e293b"
  grille <- if (isTRUE(sombre)) "#2F3D55" else "#E5EAF0"
  # The fonts of the interface (theme.R); a family name with a digit must be quoted.
  police <- "'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif"
  base <- list(
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font = list(family = police, color = texte, size = 13),
    xaxis = list(gridcolor = grille, zeroline = FALSE, fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(gridcolor = grille, zeroline = FALSE, fixedrange = TRUE),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.18),
    margin = list(l = 48, r = 16, t = 16, b = 48),
    hoverlabel = list(font = list(family = police))
  )
  modifyList(base, list(...))
}

figure <- function(data, layout, config = list()) {
  list(data = data, layout = layout,
       config = modifyList(list(modeBarButtonsToRemove = I(c("lasso2d", "select2d", "autoScale2d"))), config))
}

pct <- function(lang) if (lang == "fr") " %" else "%"

# Translation helper: tr("nav_map", "fr").
tr <- function(cle, lang = "en") {
  v <- TEXTES[[lang]][[cle]]
  if (is.null(v)) TEXTES$en[[cle]] else v
}

# Continent and income-group names as published, translated for display.
NOMS_FR <- c(
  "Africa" = "Afrique", "Asia" = "Asie", "Europe" = "Europe", "North America" = "Amérique du Nord",
  "South America" = "Amérique du Sud", "Oceania" = "Océanie",
  "Low income" = "Revenu faible", "Lower-middle income" = "Revenu intermédiaire inférieur",
  "Upper-middle income" = "Revenu intermédiaire supérieur", "High income" = "Revenu élevé",
  "World" = "Monde", "Australia & New Zealand" = "Australie et Nouvelle-Zélande",
  "Central & South Asia" = "Asie centrale et du Sud", "East & South-East Asia" = "Asie de l'Est et du Sud-Est",
  "Europe & N. America" = "Europe et Amérique du Nord", "Latin America & Caribbean" = "Amérique latine et Caraïbes",
  "N. Africa & W. Asia" = "Afrique du Nord et Asie de l'Ouest", "Oceania" = "Océanie",
  "Sub-Saharan Africa" = "Afrique subsaharienne"
)
nom_groupe <- function(x, lang) if (lang == "fr") unname(ifelse(x %in% names(NOMS_FR), NOMS_FR[x], x)) else x

# Number formats in each language: 8 160 287 632 / 8,160,287,632 ; 73,7 % / 73.7%.
fmt_nb <- function(x, lang) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = if (lang == "fr") " " else ",")
fmt_pc <- function(x, lang, d = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "-", if (lang == "fr") paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, decimal.mark = ","), " %")
         else paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d), "%"))
}
fmt_mds <- function(x, lang) {
  if (lang == "fr") paste0(formatC(x / 1e9, format = "f", digits = 2, decimal.mark = ","), " milliards")
  else paste0(formatC(x / 1e9, format = "f", digits = 2), " billion")
}

# A change in points with its sign; -0.04 shows as 0.0, not -0.0.
fmt_pts <- function(v, lang) {
  if (is.na(v)) return("-")
  v <- round(v, 1)
  paste0(if (v > 0) "+" else "", formatC(if (v == 0) 0 else v, format = "f", digits = 1,
                                         decimal.mark = if (lang == "fr") "," else "."))
}

# mod_carte.R # World map: one indicator, one residence, one year (animated slider). # Returns the ISO3 code of the country the user clicks, so that the parent # can open its profile. carte_ui <- function(id) { ns <- shiny::NS(id) bslib::layout_sidebar( sidebar = bslib::sidebar( width = 300, shiny::selectInput(ns("indicateur"), "Indicator", choices = stats::setNames(INDICATEURS, INDICATEURS)), shiny::radioButtons(ns("milieu"), "Where", choices = stats::setNames(MILIEUX, MILIEUX)), shiny::sliderInput(ns("annee"), "Year", min = ANNEES[1], max = ANNEES[2], value = ANNEES[2], step = 1, sep = "", ticks = FALSE, animate = shiny::animationOptions( interval = 900, # Inline icons, and a name for screen readers (translated by the server). playButton = htmltools::tagList(icone("play-fill", "1.4em"), htmltools::span(id = ns("lecture"), class = "visually-hidden", "Play the years")), pauseButton = htmltools::tagList(icone("pause-fill", "1.4em"), htmltools::span(id = ns("pause"), class = "visually-hidden", "Pause")))), shiny::p(class = "note", shiny::textOutput(ns("aide"), inline = TRUE)) ), bslib::layout_column_wrap( width = 1 / 3, fill = FALSE, bslib::value_box(shiny::textOutput(ns("t_monde")), shiny::textOutput(ns("v_monde")), showcase = icone("globe2"), theme = "primary"), bslib::value_box(shiny::textOutput(ns("t_sans")), shiny::textOutput(ns("v_sans")), showcase = icone("droplet-half"), theme = "danger"), bslib::value_box(shiny::textOutput(ns("t_pays")), shiny::textOutput(ns("v_pays")), showcase = icone("clipboard-data")) ), bslib::card( full_screen = TRUE, min_height = 460, bslib::card_header(shiny::textOutput(ns("titre"), inline = TRUE)), graphique_output(ns("carte"), min_height = "420px"), bslib::card_footer(class = "note", shiny::textOutput(ns("source"), inline = TRUE)) ) ) } carte_server <- function(id, lang, sombre) { shiny::moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) { # Labels follow the language; the selections are kept. shiny::observeEvent(lang(), { l <- lang() shiny::updateSelectInput(session, "indicateur", label = tr("indicator", l), choices = stats::setNames(INDICATEURS, vapply(paste0("ind_", INDICATEURS), tr, "", l)), selected = input$indicateur) shiny::updateRadioButtons(session, "milieu", label = tr("residence", l), choices = stats::setNames(MILIEUX, vapply(paste0("res_", MILIEUX), tr, "", l)), selected = input$milieu) shiny::updateSliderInput(session, "annee", label = tr("year", l)) session$sendCustomMessage("libelle", list(id = session$ns("lecture"), texte = tr("play", l))) session$sendCustomMessage("libelle", list(id = session$ns("pause"), texte = tr("pause", l))) }) output$aide <- shiny::renderText(tr("map_hint", lang())) output$source <- shiny::renderText(tr("source_short", lang())) output$t_monde <- shiny::renderText(tr("world_share", lang())) output$t_sans <- shiny::renderText(tr("people_without", lang())) output$t_pays <- shiny::renderText(tr("countries_data", lang())) output$titre <- shiny::renderText({ paste0(tr(paste0("ind_", input$indicateur), lang()), " · ", tr(paste0("res_", input$milieu), lang()), " · ", input$annee) }) # The world figures of the selected year (JMP aggregate, not a sum of # countries: the JMP imputes the countries without an estimate). monde <- shiny::reactive({ D$eau[D$eau$code == "WLD" & D$eau$year == input$annee & D$eau$residence == input$milieu, ] }) output$v_monde <- shiny::renderText(fmt_pc(monde()$safely, lang())) output$v_sans <- shiny::renderText(fmt_mds(monde()$without_safe, lang())) valeurs <- shiny::reactive({ shiny::req(input$indicateur, input$milieu, input$annee) carte_valeurs(D$eau, input$indicateur, input$milieu, input$annee) }) |> shiny::bindCache(input$indicateur, input$milieu, input$annee) output$v_pays <- shiny::renderText({ paste(sum(!is.na(valeurs()$valeur)), "/", nrow(valeurs())) }) output$carte <- render_graphique({ d <- valeurs(); l <- lang() survol <- paste0("", d$area, "
", ifelse(is.na(d$valeur), tr("no_estimate", l), fmt_pc(d$valeur, l)), "
", nom_groupe(d$continent, l)) surface <- input$indicateur == "surface" echelle <- if (surface) lapply(seq_along(ECHELLE_CARTE), function(i) list(ECHELLE_CARTE[[i]][[1]], ECHELLE_CARTE[[length(ECHELLE_CARTE) - i + 1]][[2]])) else ECHELLE_CARTE zmax <- if (surface) max(30, ceiling(max(d$valeur, na.rm = TRUE))) else 100 trait <- if (isTRUE(sombre())) "#0b1120" else "#ffffff" fond <- if (isTRUE(sombre())) "#2F3D55" else "#D7DEE7" ok <- !is.na(d$valeur) figure( list( # Grey layer under the data: countries without a national estimate. trace(type = "choropleth", geojson = "monde", featureidkey = "id", locations = d$code, z = rep(1, nrow(d)), customdata = d$code, text = survol, hoverinfo = "text", colorscale = list(list(0, fond), list(1, fond)), showscale = FALSE, marker = list(line = list(color = trait, width = 0.5))), trace(type = "choropleth", geojson = "monde", featureidkey = "id", locations = d$code[ok], z = round(d$valeur[ok], 1), customdata = d$code[ok], text = survol[ok], hoverinfo = "text", colorscale = echelle, zmin = 0, zmax = zmax, marker = list(line = list(color = trait, width = 0.5)), colorbar = list(ticksuffix = pct(l), len = 0.6, thickness = 12)) ), mise_en_page(sombre(), dragmode = FALSE, margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0), geo = list(visible = FALSE, fitbounds = "locations", bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", projection = list(type = "natural earth"))) ) }) |> shiny::bindCache(input$indicateur, input$milieu, input$annee, lang(), sombre()) # The clicked country, for the parent to open its profile. shiny::reactive(input$carte_click) }) }

name: R/mod_classement.R
content:
# mod_classement.R
# Ranking of countries for one year, filtered by continent and income group,
# searchable and sortable, with a CSV export of exactly what is shown.

TRIS <- c("safely", "basic_plus", "surface", "evolution", "population", "area")
# Label key of each sort option.
LIB_TRIS <- c(safely = "col_safely", basic_plus = "col_basic_plus", surface = "col_surface",
              evolution = "col_change", population = "col_population", area = "col_area")

classement_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- shiny::NS(id)
  bslib::layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = bslib::sidebar(
      width = 300,
      shiny::sliderInput(ns("annee"), "Year", min = ANNEES[1], max = ANNEES[2], value = ANNEES[2],
                         step = 1, sep = "", ticks = FALSE),
      shiny::selectizeInput(ns("continent"), "Continent", choices = CONTINENTS, multiple = TRUE,
                            options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"), placeholder = "All")),
      shiny::selectizeInput(ns("revenu"), "Income group", choices = REVENUS, multiple = TRUE,
                            options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"), placeholder = "All")),
      shiny::textInput(ns("cherche"), "Search a country"),
      shiny::selectInput(ns("tri"), "Sort by", choices = stats::setNames(TRIS, TRIS)),
      # Inline icon rather than Font Awesome: one stylesheet and one font less.
      shiny::downloadButton(ns("csv"), htmltools::tagList(icone("download"), " Download CSV"),
                            class = "btn-primary w-100", icon = NULL)
    ),
    bslib::card(full_screen = TRUE,
      bslib::card_header(shiny::textOutput(ns("titre"), inline = TRUE)),
      shiny::uiOutput(ns("tableau")))
  )
}

classement_server <- function(id, lang, sombre) {
  shiny::moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {

    shiny::observeEvent(lang(), {
      l <- lang()
      shiny::updateSliderInput(session, "annee", label = tr("year", l))
      shiny::updateSelectizeInput(session, "continent", label = tr("filter_continent", l),
        choices = stats::setNames(CONTINENTS, nom_groupe(CONTINENTS, l)), selected = input$continent,
        options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"), placeholder = tr("all", l)))
      shiny::updateSelectizeInput(session, "revenu", label = tr("filter_income", l),
        choices = stats::setNames(REVENUS, nom_groupe(REVENUS, l)), selected = input$revenu,
        options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"), placeholder = tr("all", l)))
      shiny::updateTextInput(session, "cherche", label = tr("search", l))
      shiny::updateSelectInput(session, "tri", label = tr("sort_by", l),
        choices = stats::setNames(TRIS, vapply(LIB_TRIS[TRIS], tr, "", l)), selected = input$tri)
      session$sendCustomMessage("libelle", list(id = session$ns("csv"), texte = tr("download", l)))
    })

    # Typing in the search box filters after a short pause, not at each key.
    cherche <- shiny::reactive(trimws(input$cherche %||% "")) |> shiny::debounce(300)

    donnees <- shiny::reactive({
      shiny::req(input$annee)
      d <- classement(D$eau, input$annee, input$continent, input$revenu)
      if (nzchar(cherche())) d <- d[grepl(cherche(), d$area, ignore.case = TRUE, fixed = FALSE) |
                                    toupper(cherche()) == d$code, ]
      tri <- if (is.null(input$tri) || !input$tri %in% TRIS) "safely" else input$tri
      ordre <- if (tri == "area") order(d$area) else order(-d[[tri]], d$area, na.last = TRUE)
      d[ordre, ]
    })

    output$titre <- shiny::renderText({
      paste0(tr("nav_table", lang()), " · ", input$annee, " · ", nrow(donnees()), " ",
             tolower(tr("country", lang())))
    })

    output$tableau <- shiny::renderUI({
      d <- donnees(); l <- lang()
      shiny::validate(shiny::need(nrow(d) > 0, tr("no_match", l)))
      tableau_html(d, legende = tr("nav_table", l), colonnes = list(
        area = list(titre = tr("col_country", l)),
        continent = list(titre = tr("col_continent", l), cellule = function(v, r) nom_groupe(v, l)),
        income = list(titre = tr("col_income", l), cellule = function(v, r) if (is.na(v)) "-" else nom_groupe(v, l)),
        safely = list(titre = tr("col_safely", l), cellule = cellule_barre("#295489", l)),
        basic_plus = list(titre = tr("col_basic_plus", l), cellule = cellule_barre("#7DA4D4", l)),
        surface = list(titre = tr("col_surface", l), cellule = cellule_barre("#b23a48", l)),
        evolution = list(titre = tr("col_change", l), num = TRUE, cellule = function(v, r) fmt_pts(v, l)),
        population = list(titre = tr("col_population", l), num = TRUE,
                          cellule = function(v, r) fmt_nb(round(v), l))))
    })

    # Exactly the rows on screen, with English column names for reuse.
    output$csv <- shiny::downloadHandler(
      filename = function() paste0("safe-water-", input$annee, ".csv"),
      content = function(fichier) {
        d <- donnees()[, c("code", "area", "continent", "income", "safely", "basic_plus", "surface",
                           "evolution", "population")]
        names(d) <- c("iso3", "country", "continent", "income_group", "safely_managed_pct",
                      "at_least_basic_pct", "surface_water_pct", "change_since_2015_pts", "population")
        utils::write.csv(d, fichier, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
      }
    )
  })
}

# mod_regions.R
# Regions and income groups since 2000, the 2030 goal, and the year each one
# would reach universal access at its 2015-2024 pace.

regions_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- shiny::NS(id)
  bslib::layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = bslib::sidebar(
      width = 300,
      shiny::radioButtons(ns("groupe"), "Group by",
                          choices = c("SDG region" = "SDG region", "Income group" = "Income group")),
      shiny::p(class = "note", shiny::textOutput(ns("note"), inline = TRUE))
    ),
    bslib::card(full_screen = TRUE, min_height = 440,
      bslib::card_header(shiny::textOutput(ns("titre"), inline = TRUE)),
      graphique_output(ns("courbes"), min_height = "380px")),
    bslib::card(
      bslib::card_header(shiny::textOutput(ns("t_rythme"), inline = TRUE)),
      shiny::uiOutput(ns("rythmes")))
  )
}

regions_server <- function(id, lang, sombre) {
  shiny::moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {

    shiny::observeEvent(lang(), {
      l <- lang()
      shiny::updateRadioButtons(session, "groupe", label = tr("group_by", l),
        choices = stats::setNames(c("SDG region", "Income group"), c(tr("grp_sdg", l), tr("grp_income", l))),
        selected = input$groupe)
    })
    output$titre    <- shiny::renderText(tr("regions_title", lang()))
    output$note     <- shiny::renderText(tr("projection_note", lang()))
    output$t_rythme <- shiny::renderText(paste(tr("pace", lang()), "·", tr("reach", lang())))

    donnees <- shiny::reactive({
      shiny::req(input$groupe)
      regions(D$eau, input$groupe)
    }) |> shiny::bindCache(input$groupe)

    zones <- shiny::reactive({
      d <- donnees()
      unique(d[order(d$order), c("code", "area")])
    })

    output$courbes <- render_graphique({
      d <- donnees(); z <- zones(); l <- lang()
      palette <- c("#1e293b", "#295489", "#7DA4D4", "#2f7d5b", "#e9c46a", "#e07a5f", "#b23a48", "#8e6bbf", "#5C6A80")
      traces <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(z)), function(i) {
        s <- d[d$code == z$code[i] & !is.na(d$safely), ]
        s <- s[order(s$year), ]
        monde <- z$code[i] == "WLD"
        trace(type = "scatter", mode = "lines", x = s$year, y = round(s$safely, 1),
              name = nom_groupe(z$area[i], l),
              line = list(color = if (monde && isTRUE(sombre())) "#e2e8f0" else palette[i],
                          width = if (monde) 4 else 2))
      })
      figure(traces, mise_en_page(sombre(),
        yaxis = list(range = c(0, 100), ticksuffix = pct(l), fixedrange = TRUE),
        xaxis = list(range = c(2000, 2031), fixedrange = TRUE), hovermode = "x unified",
        legend = list(orientation = "v", x = 1.02, y = 1),
        shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = 2000, x1 = 2030, y0 = 99, y1 = 99,
                           line = list(dash = "dot", color = "#2f7d5b", width = 2))),
        annotations = list(list(x = 2030, y = 99, text = tr("goal", l), showarrow = FALSE,
                                xanchor = "right", yanchor = "bottom", font = list(size = 12, color = "#2f7d5b")))))
    }) |> shiny::bindCache(input$groupe, lang(), sombre())

    output$rythmes <- shiny::renderUI({
      d <- donnees(); z <- zones(); l <- lang()
      t <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(z)), function(i) {
        pr <- projection(D$eau, z$code[i])
        s24 <- d$safely[d$code == z$code[i] & d$year == 2024]
        data.frame(zone = nom_groupe(z$area[i], l), s2024 = if (length(s24)) s24 else NA,
                   rythme = pr$rythme, etat = pr$etat, annee = pr$annee)
      }))
      t <- t[order(-t$s2024), ]
      tableau_html(t, legende = tr("reach", l), colonnes = list(
        zone = list(titre = ""),
        s2024 = list(titre = "2024", num = TRUE, cellule = function(v, r) fmt_pc(v, l)),
        rythme = list(titre = paste0(tr("pace", l), " (", tr("pts_year", l), ")"), num = TRUE,
          cellule = function(v, r) if (is.na(v)) "-" else formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 2,
                                                                  decimal.mark = if (l == "fr") "," else ".")),
        annee = list(titre = tr("reach", l), num = TRUE, cellule = function(v, r)
          switch(r$etat, atteint = tr("already", l), jamais = tr("never", l), inconnu = "-",
                 htmltools::tags$strong(v)))))
    })
  })
}

name: R/statiques.R
content:
# statiques.R
# The CSS and JavaScript of the page, published as static files next to the
# app ("../", as plotly.js: see R/graphique.R). Under shinylive, R would serve
# each of them itself, one after the other, and compile some with Sass first;
# static files are downloaded by the browser while R starts, compressed and
# cached. publier.R writes them:
#   theme/<dependency>/  compiled with the theme of the app (R/theme.R);
#   lib/<dependency>/    copied from the webR library, so that they match
#                        exactly the R packages webR runs.
# Each folder replaces the dependency of the same name: htmltools keeps, for
# each name, the highest version.

# Bootstrap, the bslib components, and the CSS of Shiny, selectize and the
# slider, that Shiny would otherwise compile for the current theme.
FICHIERS_THEME <- list(
  bootstrap = c("bootstrap.min.css", "bootstrap.bundle.min.js"),
  "bslib-component-css" = "bslib-component-css.min.css",
  "shiny-css" = "shiny-sass.css",
  selectize = c("selectize.css", "selectize.min.js", "selectize-plugin-a11y.min.js"),
  "ionrangeslider-css" = "ionRangeSlider.css"
)

# The other files of the page, by their path in the R library.
FICHIERS_WEBR <- list(
  jquery = "shiny/www/shared/jquery.min.js",
  "shiny-busy-indicators" = "shiny/www/shared/busy-indicators/busy-indicators.css",
  "shiny-javascript" = "shiny/www/shared/shiny.min.js",
  bs3compat = c("bslib/bs3compat/js/transition.js", "bslib/bs3compat/js/tabs.js",
                "bslib/bs3compat/js/bs3compat.js"),
  "htmltools-fill" = "htmltools/fill/fill.css",
  "bslib-component-js" = c("bslib/components/dist/components.min.js",
                           "bslib/components/dist/web-components.min.js"),
  "bslib-tag-require" = "bslib/components/tag-require.js",
  "ionrangeslider-javascript" = "shiny/www/shared/ionrangeslider/js/ion.rangeSlider.min.js",
  strftime = "shiny/www/shared/strftime/strftime-min.js"
)
MODULES_JS <- "web-components.min.js"  # loaded as ES modules

dependance_statique <- function(nom, dossier, fichiers) {
  f <- basename(fichiers)
  js <- lapply(f[endsWith(f, ".js")], function(s) c(list(src = s), if (s %in% MODULES_JS) list(type = "module")))
  htmltools::htmlDependency(
    nom, "999", src = c(href = paste0("../", dossier, "/", nom)),
    stylesheet = f[endsWith(f, ".css")], script = js,
    meta = if (nom == "bootstrap") list(viewport = "width=device-width, initial-scale=1, shrink-to-fit=no"),
    all_files = FALSE)
}

dependances_statiques <- function() {
  htmltools::tagList(
    # Placed after the navbar (rendered with the Bootstrap 5 theme): from here
    # on Shiny sees no bslib theme, so its inputs take their static CSS,
    # replaced below by the compiled files, instead of compiling it.
    htmltools::tagFunction(function() {
      shiny::shinyOptions(bootstrapTheme = NULL)
      NULL
    }),
    lapply(names(FICHIERS_THEME), function(n) dependance_statique(n, "theme", FICHIERS_THEME[[n]])),
    # In webR only: run locally, R serves the files of its own packages.
    if (identical(R.version$os, "emscripten")) {
      lapply(names(FICHIERS_WEBR), function(n) dependance_statique(n, "lib", FICHIERS_WEBR[[n]]))
    }
  )
}
